reason: Shared voice-engine library providing Qwen3-TTS speech generation, browser audio playback, voice commands, session voice events, and optional scheduled greetings for consuming plugins.

summaries.zh: 为消费插件提供基于本地 Qwen3-TTS 的语音生成、浏览器音频播放、语音命令、会话语音事件和可选定时问候能力的共享语音引擎。
summaries.en: A shared voice engine for consuming plugins that provides local Qwen3-TTS speech generation, browser audio playback, voice commands, session voice events, and optional scheduled greetings.

capabilities: Text-to-speech generation through a local Qwen3-TTS service
Voice-related commands and session event projection
Optional scheduled agent follow-ups for greetings
